comparable_reason: convexity_gap is a difference of two Shannon entropies in nats, so it is dimensionless and does not scale with width; measured over 10 models it ranges +1.8641 (gpt2) to -0.9613 (pythia-410m), i.e. it does change SIGN across models and is not saturated. Its architecture associations are moderate: spearman -0.213 with d_model, -0.418 with n_layers, -0.429 with vocab_size (n=10). What is NOT comparable is the interp_entropy_* family itself: those are the model's own next-token entropies (at alpha 0 and 1 literally so), and they carry spearman -0.82 to -0.87 with n_layers. YELLOW rather than GREEN because the reported value still depends on a probe-set size the config sets: I measured the seed-to-seed sd of convexity_gap on gpt2 at 0.2193 (50 pairs), 0.0696 (200 pairs) and 0.0434 (800 pairs) over 10 seeds each, against a 10-model spread of about 2.8, so at the shipped 200 pairs the noise is roughly 2.5% of the cross-model range -- adequate, but only because num_pairs was raised.
github_reason: The slerp kernel is the one released with dribnet/plat (plat/interpolate.py::slerp, the widely reused White 2016 formulation): normalize both endpoints, omega = arccos(clamped dot), coefficients sin((1-a)w)/sin(w) and sin(aw)/sin(w), with a lerp fallback when the vectors are near-parallel. BLME's _slerp is that function line for line, including the near-parallel guard. It is now only used for the _meta_ comparison arm, since the renormalisation to a shared target norm makes slerp and lerp identical at exactly the alphas the summaries read (I verified the consequence: _meta_slerp_convexity_gap 1.8641098058 vs convexity_gap 1.8641098225 on gpt2, a relative difference of 9e-9). No reference implementation exists for the convexity_gap statistic itself -- that is BLME's own construction, and the module says so.
paper_reason: There is no source paper that publishes a latent-interpolation entropy-convexity number for language models; the slerp reference is a code release with no numeric table, and the convexity summary is BLME's. A legitimate NONE.
